resources.string: This app wants to open the camera and receive a small photo preview. Only continue if you trust this app.
This app wants to read one measurement from a device sensor. Only continue if you trust this app.
Allow remembers this device access for all app pages at %1$s until you revoke it in Settings. Allow once applies only to this request. Android permissions are separate and cannot be bypassed.
Remembered access applies to all app pages at this origin. Revoke to ask again on the next request; data already delivered is not recalled. Android permissions remain separate.
This app wants one foreground location fix. Android location permission is also required; approximate access is supported. Only continue if you trust this app.
